subject: Fleetly onboarding: tenant access & API key plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire@fleetly.io>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fleetly.io>
Date: 2028-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fleetly onboarding: tenant access & API key plan

Hi team — quick handoff. Fleetly signed the SOW yesterday and confirmed an internal launch window of the week of April 18. I’m looping you in to coordinate initial tenant provisioning and API key seeding.

High-level:
- Deliverables: workspace + project, admin seed (2 admins), service account + seeded API keys (2), role mappings (owner/dev/viewer), invite cadence for 8 engineers.
- Customer contact: Claire Huang (technical lead) and Tom Ellis (platform ops).
- Target kickoff: week of April 10 for implementation sprint; goal to be live by Apr 18.

Attachments: Fleetly_MAP_v1.xlsx (mapping + initial access roster), SOW_Fleetly_2028-04.pdf (signed). Please review the MAP and confirm who will take lead on:
  * admin seed & API keys (technical owner)
  * roles mapping & invite cadence
  * kickoff agenda + invite

Thanks — I’ll stay on for initial handover.

— Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

[attachment: Fleetly_MAP_v1.xlsx] [attachment: SOW_Fleetly_2028-04.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@fleetly.io>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fleetly.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleetly onboarding: tenant access & API key plan

Thanks Monica — and hi Claire/Tom, excited to get this moving. Below is the implementation plan I propose; please confirm the admin roster and any constraints (KMS, SSO, IP allowlist) so we can lock the sprint.

Implementation plan (short):
1) Prep (by Apr 7) — create tenant workspace and project: project id: "fleetly-prod".
2) Admin seed (Apr 8) — seed 2 admin accounts (Owner role). Please confirm primary admin emails.
3) Service account + API keys (Apr 9) — create service account "redwood-fleetly-admin"; seed 2 API keys (one prod, one rotated). Keys delivered in secure vault link. Keys are time-limited and we’ll provide rotation guidance.
4) Roles & invites (Apr 10) — apply role templates (owner/dev/viewer) to 8 engineers; send invites via console + optional SCIM/SSO link.
5) Kickoff & tech-deep-dive (Apr 10 or 11) — 60 min: architecture, streaming/cold-start behavior, KV cache expectations.

Asks for Fleetly:
- Provide two admin emails for owner seed by Apr 6.
- Confirm whether Fleetly will bring a KMS (customer-managed) or use Redwood-managed keys. If customer KMS, please share KMS team contact and key policy.

I’ll own the timeline and client communications. Assignments:
- Monica: onboarding runbook & MAP ownership.
- Ben: technical deep-dive session and demo.
- Jordan: roles mapping & API key creation.

I attached a short checklist (see MAP). Next step: Claire/Tom — can you confirm admins and KMS preference?

— Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fleetly.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire@fleetly.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleetly onboarding: tenant access & API key plan

Thanks — Claire and I reviewed. Quick answers:
- Admins: claire@fleetly.io (Claire Huang), ops-admin@fleetly.io (shared ops mailbox).
- We prefer customer-managed keys (KMS) — we use AWS KMS (alias/keys: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ef01). Security wants key rotation policy compatibility; can you confirm Redwood supports bringing our KMS?
- Can we accelerate the kickoff to Apr 10 (earlier is better for our sprint)?
- Note: procurement will need SOW countersigned copy and invoice instructions (procurement@fleetly.io).

Also: how are the seeded API keys delivered? We need to ensure they land in our secret manager (Hashi Vault) or via a one-time secure download.

— Tom
Tom Ellis, Platform Ops — Fleetly
tom.ellis@fleetly.io

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fleetly.io>, Claire Huang <claire@fleetly.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-06T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fleetly onboarding: tenant access & API key plan

Great, thanks for the confirmations Tom — April 10 works. I booked a 60-min kickoff for Apr 10, 10:00 PT (calendar invite incoming). Agenda (brief):
- Introductions & scope (10m)
- Tenant/project walk-through (15m)
- Admin seed & API key handoff process (15m)
- Roles mapping & invite cadence (10m)
- Next steps & Q/A (10m)

Action owners & immediate asks:
- Claire: confirm the ops-admin mailbox is monitored for invites (ops-admin@fleetly.io).
- Tom: share any extra KMS policy docs if we need to open a support ticket for KMS integration.
- Monica: finalize onboarding runbook and share a pre-kickoff checklist by Apr 8. (owner: monica.patel@redwood.com)
- Ben: prepare the technical deep-dive slides and demo environment. (owner: ben.carter@redwood.com)
- Jordan: will create the project "fleetly-prod" and seed the service account + keys on Apr 9; keys will be made available via a one-time secure link and we can coordinate delivery into your Vault during the kickoff. (owner: jordan.blake@redwood.com)

Procurement: Monica, I’ll attach the countersigned SOW to the DocuSign link and loop procurement separately.

Doc link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FL-3102
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?t=FL-3102

If there are no blockers, we’ll proceed to the prep steps tomorrow. Looking forward to the kickoff — see you Apr 10.

— Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[calendar invite: Fleetly onboarding kickoff — Apr 10 10:00 PT]
